concept: Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts
summary: Source-anchored research for Linking Atlas orgs to marketplace billing accounts. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: An unavailable organization Link button signals ineligibility; its hover tooltip supplies the reason. Each provider procedure allows creation of a new organization when none is available to link. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md

A linked self-serve marketplace subscription disables editing the Atlas payment method; removing it requires unlinking through the marketplace cancellation flow. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Atlas organizations in cross-organization billing cannot have or configure an active self-serve marketplace subscription; marketplace linking is therefore not a self-serve route to cross-organization billing consolidation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

AWS and MongoDB both document Atlas pay-as-you-go procurement through AWS Marketplace; MongoDB distinguishes its self-serve subscription linking procedure from AWS Marketplace Contracts. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/prescriptive-guidance/latest/migration-mongodb-atlas/costs-licenses.html ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md

For AWS, Azure and Google Cloud self-serve marketplace billing, subscribe in the cloud marketplace, complete its MongoDB account handoff, sign in to Atlas and explicitly link the intended Atlas organization. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
Resolve every outstanding or failed invoice in the Atlas organization before linking it to a cloud marketplace billing account. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

The marketplace handoff actions differ: AWS uses Set Up Your Account, Azure uses Configure account now, and Google Cloud uses Register With MongoDB after selecting the billing account during purchase. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md

After organization selection, linking synchronizes asynchronously. The Atlas Payment Method field stays empty during synchronization and shows the provider-specific Marketplace Subscription value after success. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/gcp-self-serve-marketplace.md
With an AWS Marketplace Subscription, Atlas does not allow a credit card as backup payment. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Cancelling the AWS marketplace subscription unlinks its AWS billing account from MongoDB but does not delete Atlas resources or data, and you continue to incur charges for them; Microsoft separately documents that deleting the Atlas Azure resource stops all billing for that resource through Azure Marketplace without deleting the organization in Atlas. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/aws-self-serve-marketplace.md ; https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/partner-solutions/mongo-db/manage

Azure Native Integration provisioning creates a new Atlas organization under a selected Azure subscription and requires Azure Subscription Owner or Contributor access; the separate Azure self-serve marketplace procedure explicitly offers an existing-organization selection step. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-01-27) Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/partner-solutions/mongo-db/create ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/azure-self-serve-marketplace.md

A November 2022 GCP user reported not receiving the registration button after another person enabled the subscription. The forum response directs the user to Atlas support, and the thread establishes no generally applicable technical fix. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/mongodb-atlas-api-on-gcloud-marketplace-not-referring-me-to-the-page-select-an-organization-to-link-to-your-gcp-billing-account/202208
